text: You're burning a whole Claude prompt on a four pixel fix. Claude Design is now on every plan, even Free, and it has three ways to give feedback. Match the tool to the size of the change. Changing direction? Use chat, and ask for two or three layouts, not one. One element is off? Click it and leave an inline comment, like make this button padding larger. Just a nudge? Drag, resize or align it right on the canvas. No prompt, no model turn. Design shares usage limits with the rest of Claude, even Claude Code, so spend prompts on decisions, not pixels. You just saved one. Spend the tap on subscribe. More Claude workflows are coming.
